translate_en|mods/RainingZombies/42/medi: If checked, falling bodies will trigger bone-breaking audio and paint the pavement with blood based on how far they fell.
If checked, falling zombies that survive a 2 floor impact, or more, will become crawlers.
How much health zombies recover after hitting the ground. 100 = completely immune to fall damage. 0 = they take full vanilla fall damage.
Controls the flow of falling zombies to protect CPU performance. 15 frames is recommended. Lower numbers create a faster waterfall effect but require a stronger processor.
If checked, zombies pushed against closed windows will instantly shatter the glass and fall through. If unchecked, they will get stuck until the glass is broken normally.
Calculates how much health damage a player takes when crushed. The number is multiplied by the height of the fall. (Default 20 damage x 3 floors = 60 total damage).
If checked, zombies falling from high altitudes will cause fractures to the player on impact. Drops from higher floors cause multiple fractures. Limbs are randomly selected to fracture.
If checked, players will be knocked down if a falling zombie lands directly on their tile.
If checked, falling zombies will physically crash into zombies on the street, knocking them down
